page.overview:
What is Melania Macmillan?

Melania Black (née Macmillan) (fl. 1925-1929) was a pure-blood witch married to Arcturus Black (III). The couple had two children, Lucretia and Orion Black. She was Sirius and Regulus Black's paternal grandmother.

Melania is the Italian, Spanish or Polish version of the name Melanie, which is derived from the Greek melaina, meaning "black, dark".
